component.name: pantheon
component.purpose: Use when a genuinely contested, high-stakes, or novel question deserves a council of the greatest relevant minds — the user says "/pantheon", "convene the council on X", "what would the greats say", or nexus routes a decision that one specialist cannot carry. Sourced reasoning emulations only, never channelled individuals.

threat_note: Static scan only; runtime behaviour gated by eval + human promotion.
